C1.worst_defect: The hero offers three overlapping entry points ('Live demo', 'Quick start', 'Try with your store') and needs a caption line underneath ('Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first: the quick start sets it up.') to explain that 'Try with your store' won't work yet, so the CTA row needs a footnote to make sense.
C1.where: home/desktop/01 (hero button row and the caption under it)

C2.worst_defect: The phrase 'the plugin release after 0.3.0' comes back on home, At the till, Connect a till and Limitations (refunds, customer note, ReadOrder) with no version number or date, so the store column of the comparison table promises things against a release nobody can track.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till'; at-the-till/desktop/02 'Refund a sale'; limitations/desktop/01

C3.worst_defect: Quick start step 4 says an administrator with 'TallyPosSell (or CreateOrder)' is enough, but Connect a till says 'The till's order list needs ReadOrder, which that role gains only in the plugin release after 0.3.0; until then, add it to the role yourself'. The quick start never mentions ReadOrder, so a dev who follows it gets an order list that doesn't work.
C3.where: quick-start/desktop/02 step 4 vs connect-a-till/desktop/02 'Give each cashier their own account' item 1

C4.worst_defect: On Connect a till, a roughly 900 px privacy section ('Where your data goes', with three bold sub-labels and a build-it-yourself paragraph) sits between 'Open your till' and 'Enter your store details', which splits the sign-in steps in the middle.

C5.worst_defect: The home comparison table squeezes its longest cell into its narrowest column: 'No: the demo store lives in your browser. All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie' wraps onto 4 lines in the ~220 px 'Live demo' column, while the 'At the till' column (~340 px) and the 'Your Vendure store' column (~440 px, holding only 'Yes') sit half empty. The At the till payment screenshot has a similar density problem: shrunk to 836 px, its till labels ('incl. Standard DE 19%', 'Remaining') come out around 6 px and its cart column is mostly blank.
C5.where: home/desktop/02 table last row; at-the-till/desktop/02 payment screenshot

C6.worst_defect: At 390 px the four hero buttons wrap into two centred rows of different widths: 'Live demo' + 'Quick start' span about 110-600 px and 'Try with your store' + 'GitHub' span about 77-632 px. The edges don't line up and the primary button floats off-centre. The stacked tax table on Quick start also renders its header ('Channel pricing / taxOptions.orderTaxCalculationStrategy') looking just like a data row.
C6.where: home/phone/01 hero buttons; quick-start/phone/05 tax table

C7.worst_defect: The share card crops its till screenshot through the middle of a product row: the 'In Stock' pills and the 'Add charge' button are cut off at the bottom edge, so it reads as a clipped capture rather than a framed shot. Everything else is strong: Lighthouse 98/97, titles and descriptions on every page, llms.txt, search API, sitemap, and a styled 404.

overall_worst.defect: The 'Live demo or your own store' table, the one place the home page sets demo against real store, has unbalanced columns: the longest cell (the demo's 'No: ... ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie') wraps onto 4 lines in the narrowest column, while the store column next to it holds 'Yes' in ~440 px of empty space. The row looks broken, and the most important caveat on the page is the hardest to read.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 table, row 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline'
overall_worst.fix: Give the table fixed column widths (for example 30% / 35% / 35%), or shorten that cell to 'No: the demo store lives in your browser' and move the analytics sentence into the intro line above the table.
